# Cursor Changelog Summary

## Release Notes & Features

**Version 3.4 (May 13, 2026)**
- Development environments for cloud agents with multi-repo support
- "Improved Dockerfile-based configuration" with build secrets for secure package registry access
- Layer caching improvements reducing build times by 70%
- Agent-led environment setup with credential validation
- Environment version history, rollback controls, and audit logging
- Egress and secrets scoped at environment level

**Microsoft Teams Integration (May 11, 2026)**
- Cursor now available in Microsoft Teams
- "@Cursor" mentions delegate tasks to cloud agents or retrieve information
- Auto-selects repositories and models based on context

**Version 3.3 (May 7, 2026)**
- New PR review experience with Reviews, Commits, and Changes tabs
- "Build in Parallel" feature using async subagents for multitasking
- Split changes into PRs quick action
- Pin skills as quick-action pills
- `/multitask` command for parallel requests
- Improved MCP connection behavior and terminal interaction fixes

**Bugbot Effort Levels (May 11, 2026)**
- Default, High, and Custom effort configurations for PR reviews
- Metrics: 0.7 bugs/run (default), 0.95 bugs/run (high effort)
- 79% bug resolution rate at merge time

**Version 3.3 (May 6, 2026)**
- Context usage breakdown feature for diagnosing agent context issues

## Last Fetched
2026-05-18 — NEW: Cursor 3.4 with multi-repo cloud-agent dev environments (May 13); Microsoft Teams integration via @Cursor mentions (May 11); Cursor 3.3 with PR review tabs, "Build in Parallel" async subagents, /multitask command (May 7); Bugbot effort levels and context usage breakdown.
